blocks.ar:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
الموصولات الحرفية
blocks.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Kind. Al-mawsoolaat al-harfiyyah
The six particles shown (the last two printed in grey):
items: أَنْ
كَيْ
أَنّ
مَا
لَوْ
أَ
The above 6 words are known as {{term|الموصولات الحرفية}}.
These words also belong to other groups based on other governing factors and methods of usage.

However, they are grouped here as الموصولات الحرفية because they are "particles" which are "connected" to a sentence i.e., they {{ruling|enter upon a sentence}}. This sentence is known as a {{term|صلة}} meaning "connection".

They restructure the sentence into a compound/phrase. More specifically, into a {{ruling|مركب إضافي}} with the usage of a {{ruling|مصدر}}. The purpose of this is to enable the sentence to fall into places of {{ruling|مفرد}}, i.e., be مبتدا, فاعل, مفعول به etc. This is why they are also known as {{term|"السابكة"}} "The forming one", "The structuring one".
This process is called {{term|"بِتَأْويلِ المصدر – بِتَأْويلِ المفرد"}} with the interpretation into مصدر or مفرد. Abbreviation: {{term|BTM}}
The interpreted مصدر is called {{term|"المصدر المُؤَوَّل"}} The interpreted مصدر or {{term|"المصدر المَسْبُوْك"}} The formed مصدر.
Some can enter upon a جملة إسمية and some on a جملة فعلية.
أن is termed as {{term|المصدرية الناصبة}}.
It connects i.e., enters upon a {{condition|جملة فعلية}}. More specifically, it enters upon a verb.
The verb can be a {{condition|ماضي}} verb or a {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
If the verb is a {{condition|مضارع}}, أن will also make the مضارع verb {{ruling|منصوب}}.
It will interpret the جملة فعلية into a {{ruling|مفرد}}.
The interpreted construction will generally be a فاعل, مفعول به, مبتدا, مضاف إليه or مجرور.
a) Identifying the {{term|مصدر}} of the verb.
b) Identifying the نائب الفاعل/فاعل of the verb.
c) Extracting the نائب الفاعل/فاعل from the verb {{condition|if it's a ضمير}}.
d) Making the مصدر {{ruling|مضاف}} of the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
e) Ensuring what used to be the نائب الفاعل/فاعل is in the state of {{ruling|جر}} as a {{ruling|مضاف إليه}}.

blocks.en: Steps shown beside the first example (مصدر and مضاف in red, the rest in green):
items: a) Identify the مصدر.
b) Identify the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
c) Extract the نائب الفاعل/فاعل if it's a ضمير.
d) Make the مصدر مضاف to the نائب الفاعل/فاعل.
e) Ensure مضاف إليه is مجرور.

items: A Masdar can {{ruling|behave like a verb}} under certain circumstances.
Therefore, a جار ومجرور, ظرف, مفعول به etc will be {{ruling|dealt with as it was before the interpretation}}.

blocks.ar: أَنْ تَحْضُرَ فِي الفَصْلِ خَيْرٌ لَكَ
blocks.en: That you attend the class is better for you.

items: A Masdar can {{ruling|behave like a verb}} under certain circumstances.
Therefore, a جار ومجرور, ظرف, مفعول به etc will be {{ruling|dealt with as it was before the interpretation}}.

blocks.ar: غَضِبُوْا بِأَنْ كُسِرَ الأَصْنَامُ يَوْمَ العِيْدِ
blocks.en: They became angry that the idols were broken on the day of the festival.
the breaking of the idols on the day of the festival

items: Quite often, أن is {{term|dropped}} from the sentence. Despite It being visibly absent, it is {{ruling|assumed to be present}}.
Its presence is evident by its governing which manifests on the {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It's dropped after certain حروف. I will mention 2 here, the first being {{condition|لِ}}.

blocks.en: I learn nahw so that I understand the Qur'an.

items: Quite often, أن is {{term|dropped}} from the sentence. Despite It being visibly absent, it is {{ruling|assumed to be present}}.
Its presence is evident by its governing which manifests on the {{condition|مضارع}} verb.
It's dropped after certain حروف. I will mention 2 here, the second being {{condition|حَتّٰى}}.

blocks.en: I learn the Qur'an so that I enter Paradise. ((أن) is printed small, in yellow, before أَدْخُلَ.)

items: When a نفي is present on the verb, the نفي will be {{ruling|rephrased as an إسم}}.
The إسم will be made {{ruling|مضاف}} to the مصدر. This is done for the retention of the negation present in the original sentence.
The إسم used here is: {{term|عَدَمٌ}} (not, absence).

blocks.ar: أَنْ لَّا تَحْضُرَ فِي الفَصْلِ مُضِرٌّ لَكَ
blocks.en: That you do not attend the class is harmful for you.

items: If the اللام after which the أن is dropped, is {{condition|combined with a نفي}}, then the أن {{ruling|must be present}} in the sentence. It will not be dropped.
However, the أن will {{ruling|integrate into the لا النافية}} when written as seen in the example.

blocks.ar: أَتَعَلَّمُ النَّحْوَ لِـئَـلَّا أَغْفُلَ عَنِ القُرْآنِ
blocks.en: I learn nahw so that I am not heedless of the Qur'an.
my not being heedless of the Qur'an
